superseded.note: The older read-only status panel (integrations/herdr-app/answerback in this repository: service state, receipt counts, newest receipts, dock badge, read by running the answerback CLI). The fleet column shows all of that and more from the bridge's fleet document, so the install removes an unchanged copy of the older panel, with a backup and a line in the output, and leaves an edited one alone.
